diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`null_resource.wait_for_cluster` declares `depends_on = [aws_eks_cluster.this[0]]`, but its `local-exec` provisioner already sets `environment = { ENDPOINT = aws_eks_cluster.this[0].endpoint }`, which makes Terraform infer an implicit dependency on `aws_eks_cluster.this` anyway (the graph lists it in both implicit_deps and depends_on_deps). The explicit `depends_on` duplicates the already-established dependency and can be dropped.
